speaker: Unknown
en: At SoFi, there were times where I thought we were going to run out of money.

en: So I've been through more and figure, excuse me, Brex, we start in the kitchen.

speaker: Unknown
en: So I've been through a lot of things.

speaker: Unknown
en: But people don't say nice things in that and it never feels good.

speaker: Unknown
en: But that's kind of the risk you take and one of the negatives for going public.
zh: 但这就是你所承担的一种风险，也是上市带来的负面影响之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of the things, though, that I just say this because I think there's a lot of companies that preach this never go public.

speaker: Unknown
en: Why would you, especially Stripe?

speaker: Unknown
en: I think they're really...

speaker: Unknown
en: Pretty vocal about not going public.
zh: 对于不上市相当 vocal。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I just would counter that not every company is Stripe.
zh: 而我只是想反驳说，并非每家公司都是 Stripe。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like they don't have to go public because they have tons of investor demand for what they do.

zh: 这对他们来说很好，真的，但这并不是每家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I don't think that your plan, if your business plan is be Stripe and not go public, Stripe is kind of one-to-one.

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

en: One other question.

speaker: Unknown
en: So you, coming from operator, sorry, investor, operator, CEO, kind of run the gamut, you have this framework, this test that you call, it's called the gas station test.

speaker: Unknown
en: That's right.

en: What's the gas station test?
zh: 什么是 gas station test？

en: It comes back to when I was younger, I was walking with my dad, who's an operator, and he was telling me, he was like, look, Mikey, look at all these fancy houses here.

speaker: Unknown
en: None of these people that live in them could run a gas station.
zh: 住在这里的这些人都经营不了 gas station。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I know what he means, which is a lot of times you get people, this gets to some of the people commenting about the company, they have ideas on what you could do better.
zh: 我明白他的意思，这很多时候是指你会遇到一些人，这涉及到一些评论公司的人，他们对你可以做得更好有想法。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's like, you have to be able to run a business if you want to work in the operating world.
zh: 但就像，如果你想在 operator 领域工作，你必须能够经营一项业务。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you have to be the kind of person that was put in a gas station and would know what to do, how to price the gas and just figure it out.
zh: 你必须是那种被放在 gas station 里并且知道该做什么，如何为汽油定价，并且 just figure it out 的人。

en: And what I've really tried to do in every role that I've been,
zh: 我真正努力在我在过的每个角色中做的事情，

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you see people in the company that are like, what do they mean by this?
zh: 如果你在公司里看到那些人，比如，他们这是什么意思？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like, you're just totally out of it.
zh: 就像，你完全 out of it。

en: If there's feedback that we're giving, I'm going to have an idea of what they're talking about 90% of the time.
zh: 如果有我们在给出的 feedback，我会 90% 的时间知道他们在说什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, there's going to be some things and that could be a bug or something, but a lot of times that's a real tell.
zh: 当然，会有一些事情，那可能是一个 bug 之类的，但很多时候那是一个真正的 tell。

en: So it's like pyramid structure of businesses, like management.
zh: 所以这就像企业的 pyramid structure，像 management。

speaker: Unknown
en: How do you feel about that?
zh: 你对此感觉如何？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, and this also gets to the gas station test, right?
zh: 嗯，这也涉及到 gas station test，对吧？

en: In the investor kind of consulting law firm world, you get this pyramid where all the junior people do all the work and the top people kind of like relationship manage and go out to dinner, et cetera.
zh: 在 investor 类型的 consulting law firm 世界，你会得到这个 pyramid，所有的 junior 人员做所有的工作，而高层人员有点像 relationship manage 并去吃晚餐，等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: But in an operating world, it's the opposite.
zh: 但在 operator 世界，这是相反的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Really?
zh: 真的吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: In terms of like that, yeah.
zh: 就像那样而言，是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think the stress and the, I mean, maybe other people would say otherwise, but I definitely think that it's, without making it about me, it is a reverse pyramid for sure.
zh: 我认为这种压力，我是说，也许别人会说不一样，但我绝对认为，这并不是在谈论我个人，这绝对是一个倒金字塔。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you think that the best operators embrace that?
zh: 你认为最好的运营者会拥抱这一点吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Embrace that.

en: It's not easy, but nobody's forcing me to do it.

speaker: Unknown
